summary: Live Perps Pro (iOS, mmdev-1) evidence for the three copy corrections in PR #34267. All 3 claims PROVEN; recipe trace 22/22 nodes passed. The order-pill image is the strongest single proof: it shows the bare 'Limit' pill and the 'Stop market' pill in one frame.

standalone.label: Claim 2 — Orders tab type pills: bare 'Limit' (SOL, reduce-only No) and 'Stop market' (ETH) in one frame
standalone.note: Pre-PR the SOL order rendered 'Open limit' and the ETH trigger rendered 'Stop'. Both halves of the AND-claim are visible here, so this is the primary claim-2 proof.

standalone.label: Claim 1 — Perps Pro order form size label reads 'Size (USD)'
standalone.note: Backed by the typed assertion ui.wait_for test_id=perps-pro-order-form-size-input text='Size (USD)'; pre-PR string was 'Size USD'.

standalone.label: Claim 3 — positions side filter sheet lists 'All sides' first, and the collapsed filter button matches
standalone.note: Backed by the typed assertion on ...side-filter-sheet-option-all with text 'All sides'; pre-PR key all_types rendered 'All types'.

standalone.label: Claim 2 corroboration — BTC 'Stop market' and ETH 'Take profit limit' pills further down the Orders list
standalone.note: Secondary; confirms the detailed-type pills on trigger orders beyond the primary frame.

videos.note: Full recording of the passing 22-node recipe run on iOS (mmdev-1); moov atom verified. Screenshots are the preferred proof.
